题目.题目1:
【听力】听录音，回答问题：说话人请对方做什么？
听：Could you open the window, please?
A. 关窗
B. 开窗
C. 擦窗
D. 关门
题目.题目2:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：Don't lean out of the ______; we're on the tenth floor.
A. widow
B. wind
C. window
D. winter
题目.题目3:
【选词填空】从 window、windowsill 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
题干：She put a plant on the ______.
考点：易混
题目.题目4:
【适当形式填空】用所给单词的适当形式填空。
题干：There are four ______ in my bedroom. (window)
考点：变形
题目.题目5:
【改错】句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
题干：The windows was cleaned yesterday.
题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："A window of opportunity" means ______.
A. a short time when you can do something
B. a big window
C. a shop window
D. a broken window
考点：用法
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："Window-shopping" means ______.
A. looking at things in shops without buying
B. buying windows
C. cleaning windows
D. selling things
考点：短语
题目.答案:
【1】B（开窗）
讲解：open the window 开窗。
【2】C（window）
讲解：往外探身的是窗户 window。
【3】windowsill
讲解：放花盆的窗台是 windowsill。
【4】windows
讲解：four 后面用复数 windows。
【5】was → were
讲解：主语 windows 是复数，be 用 were。
【6】A（a short time when you can do something）
讲解：window 也指“时机、机会窗口”。
【7】A（looking at things in shops without buying）
讲解：window-shopping 逛橱窗，只看不买。
